decision_rationale: The abstract describes Phenformer as a multi-scale genetic language model that generates mechanistic hypotheses from DNA sequence. It also uses whole-genome sequencing from more than 150,000 individuals and reports generalisation to diverse populations, which supports foundation-model-like breadth.
evidence_snippet: "learns to generate mechanistic hypotheses"; "using whole genome sequencing data from more than 150 000 individuals"; "generalisation to diverse populations"; "multi-scale genetic language model"
